desc: 3 Eyes Multi Use Pancake Pan Divided Frying Pan Egg Pancake Omelette Katayef The 3-eye design pancake pan helps to prepare more than one type of food inside the pan in a practical way. Separate compartments provide dedicated spaces for preparing eggs, pancakes, omelettes and katayifs, making them suitable for preparing breakfasts and various recipes at home. The three eyes design helps separate ingredients during cooking, with multiple pieces in the same pan depending on the type of recipe. The contoured compartments also provide a tidy shape to the ingredients during preparation, making it a practical addition to the kitchen utensils used in preparing meals. 3-Compartment Design The pan has three separate sections that help distribute ingredients during preparation, enabling the preparation of several pieces or items according to the nature of the food and the desired cooking method. Suitable for making pancakes: the contoured eyes help to place the pancake batter inside separate compartments, making it easy to prepare closely shaped pieces while preparing breakfast or snacks. Egg preparation: one or more eyes can be used to prepare eggs in a practical way, with each piece remaining in a separate space while cooking.
